mapper.select: select cp.id, cp.club_id, cp.author_member_id, cp.content, cp.images, cp.ref_type, cp.ref_id, cp.type, cp.like_count, cp.comment_count, cp.repost_count, cp.del_flag, cp.is_pinned, cp.pinned_at, cp.version, cp.create_time, cp.update_time, exists(select 1 from club_post_revision r where r.post_id = cp.id) as edited from club_post cp where cp.id = #{id}

select id, club_id, author_member_id, content, images, ref_type, ref_id, type, like_count, comment_count, repost_count, del_flag, is_pinned, pinned_at, version, create_time, update_time from club_post where id = #{id} for update

select cp.id, cp.club_id, cp.author_member_id, cp.content, cp.images, cp.ref_type, cp.ref_id, cp.type, cp.like_count, cp.comment_count, cp.repost_count, cp.del_flag, cp.is_pinned, cp.pinned_at, cp.version, cp.create_time, cp.update_time, exists(select 1 from club_post_revision r where r.post_id = cp.id) as edited, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, c.name as clubName, c.logo as clubLogo from club_post cp left join ums_member m on m.id = cp.author_member_id join club c on c.id = cp.club_id and c.del_flag = 0 where cp.del_flag = 0 and cp.club_id in #{cid} order by cp.id desc limit #{limit}

select cp.id, cp.club_id, cp.author_member_id, cp.content, cp.images, cp.ref_type, cp.ref_id, cp.type, cp.like_count, cp.comment_count, cp.repost_count, cp.del_flag, cp.is_pinned, cp.pinned_at, cp.version, cp.create_time, cp.update_time, exists(select 1 from club_post_revision r where r.post_id = cp.id) as edited, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, c.name as clubName, c.logo as clubLogo from club_post cp left join ums_member m on m.id = cp.author_member_id join club c on c.id = cp.club_id and c.del_flag = 0 and c.status = 1 where cp.del_flag = 0 and (c.public_visible is null or c.public_visible <> 0 or c.member_id = #{viewerId} or exists(select 1 from club_member cm where cm.club_id = c.id and cm.member_id = #{viewerId} and cm.status = 1 and cm.del_flag = 0)) and not exists(select 1 from im_block b where (b.member_id = #{viewerId} and b.blocked_member_id = cp.author_member_id) or (b.member_id = cp.author_member_id and b.blocked_member_id = #{viewerId})) and cp.id < #{beforeId} order by cp.id desc limit #{limit}

select cp.id, cp.club_id, cp.author_member_id, cp.content, cp.images, cp.ref_type, cp.ref_id, cp.type, cp.like_count, cp.comment_count, cp.repost_count, cp.del_flag, cp.is_pinned, cp.pinned_at, cp.version, cp.create_time, cp.update_time, exists(select 1 from club_post_revision r where r.post_id = cp.id) as edited, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, c.name as clubName, c.logo as clubLogo from club_post cp left join ums_member m on m.id = cp.author_member_id join club c on c.id = cp.club_id and c.del_flag = 0 where cp.del_flag = 0 and cp.id in #{pid}
mapper.insert: insert into club_post (club_id, author_member_id, content, images, ref_type, ref_id, type, like_count, comment_count, del_flag, is_pinned, version, create_time) values (#{clubId}, #{authorMemberId}, #{content}, #{images}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{type}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update club_post set del_flag = 2 where id = #{id}
update club_post set like_count = greatest(ifnull(like_count, 0) + #{delta}, 0) where id = #{id}
update club_post set comment_count = greatest(ifnull(comment_count, 0) + #{delta}, 0) where id = #{id}
update club_post set repost_count = greatest(ifnull(repost_count, 0) + #{delta}, 0) where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, post_id, member_id, del_flag, create_time from club_post_repost where post_id = #{postId} and member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into club_post_repost (post_id, member_id, del_flag, create_time) values (#{postId}, #{memberId}, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update club_post_repost set del_flag = 0, create_time = #{createTime} where id = #{id} and del_flag = 2
update club_post_repost set del_flag = 2 where post_id = #{postId} and member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = 0
mapper.select: select post_id from club_post_repost where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = 0 and post_id in #{pid}
